passages.text: Ella wants to join the music club, but she knows little about playing with a group. The members invite her to listen before choosing an instrument. At first, she notices only the loud drum at the front. Then she learns to appreciate the careful work of the quieter players too. A soft tune from the back helps connect the different parts of the song. Ella asks to practise that part, and another member sits beside her to help. Listening first gives her a better understanding of how the whole group works.

parallelText.zh: 成员邀请她先聆听，再选择乐器。

parallelText.en: At first, she notices only the loud drum at the front.
parallelText.zh: 起初，她只注意到前面响亮的鼓。

parallelText.en: Then she learns to appreciate the careful work of the quieter players too.
parallelText.zh: 接着，她也学会欣赏声音较轻的演奏者的细致努力。

parallelText.en: A soft tune from the back helps connect the different parts of the song.
parallelText.zh: 后方传来的轻柔曲调帮助连接乐曲的不同部分。

parallelText.en: Ella asks to practise that part, and another member sits beside her to help.
parallelText.zh: 埃拉请求练习那一部分，另一位成员坐在旁边帮助她。

parallelText.en: Listening first gives her a better understanding of how the whole group works.
parallelText.zh: 先聆听让她更理解整个团队怎样运作。

a series of musical notes forming a melody

passages.text: Our reading group chooses a short story from a book of literature. It tells of a young gardener who asks an older neighbour for help. We decide to show one part of the story as a short play. I act the part of the gardener, while Mia plays the neighbour. Before speaking our lines, we discuss why each character makes a different choice. The performance helps us notice ideas that we miss when we read quickly. Afterwards, everyone returns to the book with new questions about the characters.

parallelText.en: Our reading group chooses a short story from a book of literature.
parallelText.zh: 我们的阅读小组选了一本文学作品集里的短篇故事。

parallelText.en: It tells of a young gardener who asks an older neighbour for help.
parallelText.zh: 故事讲一位年轻园丁向年长邻居求助。

parallelText.en: We decide to show one part of the story as a short play.
parallelText.zh: 我们决定把故事的一部分演成短剧。

parallelText.en: I act the part of the gardener, while Mia plays the neighbour.
parallelText.zh: 我扮演园丁，米娅扮演邻居。

parallelText.en: Before speaking our lines, we discuss why each character makes a different choice.
parallelText.zh: 说台词前，我们讨论每个角色为何做出不同选择。

parallelText.en: The performance helps us notice ideas that we miss when we read quickly.
parallelText.zh: 表演帮助我们注意到快速阅读时忽略的想法。

parallelText.en: Afterwards, everyone returns to the book with new questions about the characters.
parallelText.zh: 之后，每个人都带着关于角色的新问题回到书中。

wordHelp.meaning: a person in a story or play
acting, music or another activity shown to an audience
